features.name: Kiwanis Reservation Area
features.description: Kiwanis Reservation Area is Elena Gallegos' large sheltered group-picnic destination, with room for up to 250 people, three coal grills, a volleyball net, horseshoes, running water, electricity, restrooms, and direct trail access.
